==Hero Usage==
* Heroes only use this skill to remove conditions; they will not cast Dismiss Condition on enchanted allies just to heal.

== Notes ==
* This skill removes the condition before applying any healing, which allows it to heal at full strength when removing [[Deep Wound]].
* Dismiss Condition always heals enchanted targets, whether a condition is removed or not.

{{anomaly|Unlike most other skills with a healing component, Dismiss Condition can target [[spirit]]s.}}
